name: Supabase
profile:
## Supabase — Hackathon Builder Profile

**Supabase** is a backend platform for shipping full-stack apps fast, with a strong fit for web and mobile prototypes.

### Capabilities and APIs you can use in a weekend
- **Postgres database** with Realtime, backups, and extensions
- **Auth** for email/password, passwordless, OAuth, and mobile logins
- **Storage** for serving and transforming files, integrated with Postgres and Row Level Security policies
- **Realtime** for listening to database changes, syncing state across clients, and broadcasting to channels
- **Edge Functions** for globally distributed server-side code close to users
- **AI & Vectors**, **Cron**, **Queues**
- **Data REST API** and **GraphQL API**
- Client libraries for **JavaScript, Flutter, Python, C#, Swift, Kotlin**
- Quickstarts for many frameworks/mobile stacks, including **Next.js, React, Vue, SvelteKit, Astro, Flutter, Expo, Android Kotlin, iOS SwiftUI, Laravel, Rails, Spring Boot**

### Hero use cases the docs emphasize
- Building a **complete backend platform** from database to app logic
- **Connecting a framework quickly** via quickstarts
- **Mobile and web apps** with auth, storage, realtime sync, and server-side logic
- **AI-enabled apps**, scheduled workflows, and queue-based processing
- **Migrating existing apps** from systems like Firebase, Auth0, MySQL, Postgres, and others

### What it rewards in hackathon projects
The docs don’t list judging criteria or prizes, but they strongly signal value in projects that:
- Use **multiple Supabase primitives together** end-to-end
- Show **fast startup/clear integration** with a supported framework
- Demonstrate **realtime**, **auth**, **storage**, or **edge execution** in a polished app
- Leverage **RLS-secured storage/database access** or migration from another stack

### Recent or notable features worth building on now
- **AI & Vectors**
- **Cron** and **Queues**
- **GraphQL API**
- **Edge Functions**
- The docs also highlight the **Supabase CLI** workflow and an **AI-assisted setup path** via “Build with AI tools” / “Ask AI” style guidance

prior_art.title: 6DAYS
prior_art.excerpt: ### About the Project The idea for **6days** was inspired by my own experience as an international student in Korea. Many students often felt isolated, unsure of how to join events, or hesitant to approach student clubs and associations. Besides, in Korea, local students can easily join various clubs outside campus, through existing apps, but for foreigners, these platforms are difficult to use because **almost everything is in Korean**. This creates a barrier to participation and leaves many international students missing out on valuable opportunities. **6days** was built to break this barrier by providing a bilingual, accessible platform that helps students connect with clubs, events, and communities without language being an obstacle. * * * ### Inspiration * I noticed how difficult it was for new students to discover events without knowing Korean well. * Friends often told me they wis

prior_art.title: joshcawthorne/LunaDesk
prior_art.excerpt: The people-first scheduling tool, coming in a year starting with a 2. LunaDesk is a web app, originally created by Josh Cawthorne and known as "WorkFrom" for the Supabase Hackathon. ![LunaDesk Logo](https://lunadesk.netlify.app/images/githubPhoto.jpg) # LunaDesk ### What is LunaDesk? LunaDesk is a web app created by Josh Cawthorne for the Supabase Hackathon. The concept of the app is for companies to be able to sign-up, and enable employees to share which days they're working in the office, and which days they're working from home, to allow better planning on when teams should be in the office
